steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about fishing.
choices: You think so?
What can I learn about the use of a fishing rod?

steps.text: Search the bed in Otto's hut.
Fish from one of the fishing spots near Otto's hut.
Return to Otto and tell him about your success.
choices: I've fished with a barbarian rod!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about barehand fishing.
choices: You think so?
Please teach me of your cunning with harpoons.

steps.text: Fish in a fishing spot which requires a harpoon WITHOUT a harpoon.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: Barbarian Outpost.
I've fished with my hands!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about firemaking.
choices: You think so?
I'm ready for your firemaking wisdom. Please instruct me.

steps.text: Use a bow on some oak logs to light it.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've set fire to logs with a bow!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about advanced firemaking.
choices: I have completed firemaking with a bow. What follows this?

steps.text: Jump into the whirlpool north of Otto. Be prepared to fight mithril dragons.
Climb down the stairs. There are brutal green dragons there, so have antifire protection and Protect from Magic on!
Climb up the stairs to the south-east. Be ready to fight the mithril dragons!
Kill mithril dragons until you get some chewed bones.
Pick up the chewed bones.
Construct a pyre on the lake near Otto.
Return to Otto and tell him about the succesful pyre-making.
choices: I've created a pyre ship!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about farming.
choices: You think so?
How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?

steps.text: Plant a seed in a patch WITHOUT a dibber. This can fail, so bring multiple and preferably use cheap seeds.

items.name: Any seed that can be planted directly

steps.text: Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've planted seeds with my fists!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about advanced farming.
choices: Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?

steps.text: Plant a sapling in a tree or fruit tree patch.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've smashed a pot whilst farming!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about spears.
choices: Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Make a bronze spear on the anvil south of Otto.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've created a spear!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about hastae.
choices: Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Make a bronze hasta on the anvil south of Otto.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've created a hasta!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about herblore.
choices: What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?

steps.text: Search the bed in Otto's hut.
Fish from one of the fishing spots near Otto's hut.
Dissect the fish with a knife until you get some roe.
Use roe on an attack potion (2).
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: I've made a barbarian potion!
